newsArticles.title: Edo State Government Commissions Modernized Greenhouse & Tractor Mechanization Hub at Iguoriakhi
newsArticles.author: Information & Protocol Directorate
newsArticles.content: In fulfillment of the agricultural transformation blueprint for Edo State, the executive governor has officially commissioned the expanded Iguoriakhi Campus mechanization complex. The modern infrastructure provides students of Agricultural Technology, Bio-Environmental Engineering, and Agronomy with hands-on exposure to mechanized seeders, automated harvesters, and solar-powered drip irrigation grids.
newsArticles.summary: His Excellency commissions expanded 1,500-acre smart irrigation demonstration perimeter, automated climate greenhouses, and heavy farm equipment workshops.

newsArticles.title: Academic Board Announces 2025/2026 Online Screening & Admission Criteria
newsArticles.author: Office of the College Registrar
newsArticles.content: The College Admissions Committee wishes to inform the general public and prospective applicants that online registration for the 2025/2026 academic session has formally commenced. All candidates with minimum requirements in WAEC/NECO/NABTEB are invited to upload their biodata and examination credentials directly through the integrated portal.
newsArticles.summary: Prospective National Diploma (ND) and Higher National Diploma (HND) candidates can now apply and track real-time O-Level vetting online.

newsArticles.title: EDOCASTI Computer Science & Agro-Informatics Faculty Deploys AI Crop Disease Diagnostics Model
newsArticles.author: ICT & Applied Innovation Centre
newsArticles.content: Staff and student researchers from the Department of Computer Science & Software Systems, in active collaboration with the Department of Agricultural Technology, have launched a pilot mobile-ready machine learning model capable of detecting early fungal blight and pest infestation from smartphone farm photos.
newsArticles.summary: Innovative collaboration between School of Applied Sciences and School of Agricultural Technology yields real-time cassava and maize blight detection tool.

newsArticles.title: Bursary Notice: Seamless Remita Electronic Payment Reconciliation for Consolidated Fees
newsArticles.author: Directorate of Bursary & Accounts
newsArticles.content: The Bursary Directorate has streamlined all student fees collections. Payment references (RRR) are dynamically generated per enrolled semester, allowing instant verification and automated production of printable electronic bursary receipts recognized for examination hall clearance.
newsArticles.summary: Students are advised to generate authenticated invoices via the portal and verify payments instantly without physical bank queuing.
